name: Valhi (VHI)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Valhi's market value roughly equals its direct Kronos stake, but Contran controls 91% and decides when the discount closes. Confidence C requires a 42.5% margin of safety, so the buy zone starts at $13.48.
llms: Contran-controlled U.S. holding company owning about 75% of Kronos Worldwide (titanium dioxide) through direct and NLI Holdings stakes, about 72% of CompX and Henderson, Nevada real estate notes, valued on a look-through sum of the parts with Kronos at normalized EBITDA, capitalized group overhead and a 35% holding discount. Bear $7.79, Base $23.45, Bull $48.08. Verdict HOLD at $14.55 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $13.48.
